dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Don't be too weirded out if you see me with my mask off while we rest. I'm just getting some fresh air.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: This place is way too idle, it gets to you after a while... Got to take some deep breaths.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Not that I'm rushing you, of course. I'll wait until you've made your preparations in full.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You can leave the trickier opponents to me.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You did invite me here, after all, so I'll do my part for the cause, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: As for what part that'll be exactly, arrange that however you wish. I can handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I do hope I'll get to read a story about a rebellious princess. You know, the type who sheds her long, cumbersome skirts, and learns equestrianism, swordplay... perhaps even medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: She'll live freely, take to the field to defeat evil personally, and defend the people and nation by her own hand...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...Hmm. You know what? I might just write that story myself.
